purpose: Rebuild the detailed method and diagnose the failed early-preprint approximation

reported.hidden_network: modified MLP with two input encoders and multiplicative gates
reported.transform: fifth root then train-only min/max to [-1,1]
reported.refine_loss: only the final K-step endpoint MSE, with gradient through all self-fed predictions

explicit_choices_and_limits.framework: independent PyTorch CPU mathematical port, not original JAX weights
explicit_choices_and_limits.fusion: three-way Hadamard product of branch/trunk/ParamNet, followed by five 40-term sums; exact private fusion code unavailable
explicit_choices_and_limits.time_zero: include tau=0 in training; log input uses a declared 1e-12-second numerical floor; there is no identity skip or output clipping in training
explicit_choices_and_limits.mechanism_limit: Verified reduction of the public 2011/2012 Burke release: 10 species, 25 Cantera rate entries. Thesis describes 20 reactions; exact author's mechanism file is unavailable. Do not claim that count or exact mechanism identity
explicit_choices_and_limits.normalization: fit only on the 99 training ICs, not validation/test
explicit_choices_and_limits.validation_selection: finite unconstrained representative trajectory coverage, then joint5 curve accuracy count, median worst5, fixed-window MSE; physical validity is reported separately and required for every final joint_pass. Never call a negative-species diagnostic an admissible raw success
explicit_choices_and_limits.protocol_final_evaluation: Also evaluate literal last protocol weights, separately from validation selection, on all held-out representative trajectories, with and without strict admissibility checks. Never hide degraded refinement by showing an earlier checkpoint only
explicit_choices_and_limits.full_state_reconstruction: Separate 5-64-64-6 tanh ANN; architecture not specified numerically by the thesis. Constant AR=0 is declared. Its errors are reported separately from the operator
explicit_choices_and_limits.accuracy: joint5 for direct representatives; joint9 for T plus eight reacting species. N2/AR separate. NRMSE=RMSE(Cantera,NN)/RMS(Cantera), ratio, not percent
explicit_choices_and_limits.success_reporting: No claim of paper-performance reproduction from loss or temperature alone; score all held-out cases and early 0.1 ms; incomplete gets no full-horizon score
